ambiguous_manifest: Several installable subprojects, none of them obviously the agent
env_check_timeout: Container environment probe did not finish in time
host_out_of_disk: The machine running the build ran out of disk
needs_credentials: Requires credentials we do not supply
no_installable_manifest: No installable manifest at the repository root
python_version_unsupported: Requires a Python version the base image does not provide
unsupported_language: Written in a language this recipe does not build
workspace_root_not_installable: The manifest found is a workspace root, not an installable package
